name: UI Control
description: See what the user is seeing right now — their open windows (chats, terminal sessions, boards…), layout, focus and devices — and drive their interface in real time: open, close, update, focus windows, switch desktops, split panes, toggle navbar/theme. Browser tabs: view and act on the page the user is viewing (get-state/click/type/screenshot) via request-response, with consent OFF by default and a take-over fence. Tabs: open/close tabs in a pane beside the user, scroll and press keys.

changelog.notes: Browser tabs and more inputs (spec DBAC, docs/specs/20261031_desktop-browser-agent-control.md): browser-open-tab (opens a browser window in a pane — right by default — on the user's desktop app, waits for the device to report it and returns its tabId), browser-list-tabs (tabId/url/title/focused per device), browser-close-tab, browser-scroll (trusted wheel, direction + amount, optional ref) and browser-press-key (named key or one character with Alt/Control/Meta/Shift). Two new ui.command kinds: browser.scroll and browser.press-key. The desktop shell (teros-desktop) now ships the main-process executor (CDP) with the consent toggle in the tab's toolbar (OFF by default) and the take-over fence — the F3 loop is closed end to end.

Browser control (Teros Desktop F3, task tn_Q9fbZS5wwxWiYRPl): six new tools — browser-get-state (a11y tree with [ref=eNN] + page info, optional screenshot attachment), browser-click (trusted input by ref or x,y), browser-type (trusted text input, optional clear/submit), browser-screenshot (downscaled JPEG attachment), browser-open-url (top-level navigation), browser-control (consent + fence status, advisory take/release). Request-response over the existing UI channel (correlationId + ui.command-result, 25s timeout) — no new MCA, no pairing, no tunnel (decision Pablo 31-oct). Consent 'the agent may handle my browser' OFF by default; take-over fence blocks agent inputs while the user interacts (human_has_control). Six new ui.command kinds: browser.open-url/get-state/click/type/screenshot/control — single-device, single-session delivery.

Full agent UI control (task tn_BGpRYoeD7HdoziO5): ui-open gains desktopId (targeted open — the user's view switches to that desktop; unknown desktopId is a clear UI_UNKNOWN_DESKTOP error) and pane (left/right/top/bottom — the window lands in its own split pane; an empty desktop absorbs the first window). New tools: ui-create-desktop (cap 10, optional name), ui-remove-desktop (windows migrate to the previous desktop, never the last one), ui-set-navbar (collapse/expand/toggle), ui-set-theme (dark/light/toggle). Four new ui.command kinds: create-desktop, remove-desktop, set-navbar-collapsed, set-theme — all frontend actions (target 'active').

Initial release (spec 20261022_ui-state-mca.md, REQ-5) — ui-state reads the user's live desktop per device (windows, layout, focus, dynamic window-type catalog, enriched names); ui-open / ui-close / ui-update-props broadcast window changes to all devices; ui-focus / ui-set-desktop are frontend actions on the active device. Thin wrapper over the backend ui.* domain via the admin_request bridge.
